call_args.rdi: map pointer (&S+0x20 in the insert helper)
call_args.rsi: additional capacity requested (1 from the insert); needed = rsi + word at map+0x18 (items), checked add
call_args.rdx: map+0x20 in the only call; never dereferenced by the body (see third_argument)
call_args.rcx: fallibility byte in the low byte (1 from the insert): nonzero routes failures to the panic / alloc-error calls, zero makes them return a tag in rax

third_argument: no instruction in the body loads through the incoming rdx; it is overwritten by the divide-by-7 magic (0x4742b61), by the group-count mask (0x4742e96), by the memmove length (0x4742f30), by the in-place bucket cursor (0x47431e7) and by the panic location (0x474331d) before any use; the [rdx] loads in the in-place swap loop read through a bucket pointer the loop itself computes from the scan index

capacity_model.rule: cap(B) = (B & ~7) - (B >> 3), or B-1 when B-1 < 8; requested = max(cap(old buckets)+1, needed); new buckets = 4 / 8 / 16 for requested < 4 / < 8 / < 15, else the smallest power of two strictly greater than floor(8*requested/7) - 1

map_rewrites: allocation path: map+0x00 = new control pointer (alloc base + align16(new buckets * 0x58)), map+0x08 = new mask (new buckets - 1), map+0x10 = cap(new buckets) - items; map+0x18 (items) is not stored
in-place path: only map+0x10 is stored, with cap(old buckets) - items; map+0x00, map+0x08 and map+0x18 are not stored
failure returns store no map word
phases: entry: needed = additional + items (checked); old buckets B = mask + 1; if needed <= cap(B)/2 the body takes the in-place path, otherwise the allocation path

allocation size: requested = max(cap(B)+1, needed); new buckets by the capacity model; total = align16(new buckets * 0x58) + new buckets + 16, with overflow checks at each step; alloc through slot 0x64df480
fresh block: new control pointer = base + align16(new buckets * 0x58); memset of new buckets + 16 control bytes to 0xff through slot 0x64df750; the bucket area is left uninitialised

rehash (allocation path): old control groups scanned in order; each full slot's key is rehashed with the 0xff-terminated FNV-1a; the 0x58-byte record is copied to the first special byte of the probe run from hash & new mask in 16-byte group steps (a full byte there falls back to the first special byte of the first group); pattern byte = hash >> 0x39 stored at the slot and its mirror (index - 0x10) & new mask; the loop ends when the item count is exhausted; items == 0 skips the loop entirely

install and free: map+0x00/+0x08/+0x10 are stored as listed in map_rewrites; the old allocation base (old control pointer minus align16(old buckets * 0x58)) is freed through slot 0x64df4a0 with the old total size when the old mask is nonzero

in-place fixup: every control byte is rewritten with pcmpgtb against 0 ORed with the 0x80 vector at 0x454f80 (full bytes become 0x80, empty/deleted become 0xff), one 16-byte group directly when the table has at most 16 buckets, group pairs plus a possible tail group otherwise

in-place mirror and scan: one memmove call (slot 0x64df568) copies the control head into the mirror area (16 bytes from ctrl to ctrl + buckets when buckets >= 16, else buckets bytes from ctrl to ctrl + 16); the scan then visits indexes 0..mask, and for each 0x80-marked record rehashes its key and probes the same table: a destination in the same group takes only the pattern byte (and its mirror) at the destination; a 0xff destination receives the whole 0x58-byte record and the source byte becomes 0xff; any other destination swaps the two buckets qword by qword and the scan retries the same index
in-place finish: growth left = cap(B) - items is stored at map+0x10 and the body returns; the degenerate mask == -1 entry (buckets wraps to 0) reaches only this recompute with a zero capacity word

failures: checked-add overflow, requested > 0x1fffffffffffffff, buckets * 0x58 overflow, total-size overflow past 0x7fffffffffffffff - 15 and a null allocation reach 0x4742bd1; with the fallibility byte nonzero, overflow first calls the panic formatter (slot 0x64df6b8, message at 0x49bd80, raw length argument 0x39, location record at 0x641cc98) and then the alloc-error slot 0x64df490 with (0x10, total size), which the null path calls directly; with the byte 0 the overflow path returns rax = 0 and the null path returns rax = 0x10, storing nothing
verdict: The grow body 0x4742aa0 is the hashbrown-style reserve behind the S-rooted map, reached only through slot 0x64eaf78 from the map insert (map, 1, map+0x20, 1). It forms needed = 1 + items and splits on needed <= cap(old buckets)/2: below the split it rehashes in place -- control bytes are flipped through the 0x80-vector fixup (full -> 0x80, special -> 0xff), the control head is mirrored with one memmove, marked records are re-placed by moving or swapping buckets, and only growth-left at map+0x10 is rewritten (cap - items). Above the split it allocates a fresh block sized for the smallest bucket count whose 7/8 capacity covers max(cap+1, needed), fills the new control block with 0xff, rehashes every stored record with the same 0xff-terminated FNV-1a into the new table (pattern byte = hash >> 0x39, slot plus mirror), installs control pointer, mask and growth-left at map+0x00/+0x08/+0x10 -- never the item count -- and frees the old block when the old mask is nonzero. The map+0x20 third argument is never read: rdx is overwritten in every path before any load through it.
